0022600210.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (4-6, 11th in the West, 1-3 on the road, and on a two-game losing streak) visit the Golden State Warriors (7-3, 5th in the West, on a seven-game winning streak and 5-1 at home). Yves Missi is out for New Orleans with a knee bruise, while Golden State is without Jimmy Butler III (knee surgery), Kristaps Porzingis (illness), Moses Moody (knee surgery), and Will Richard (thumb), and Gary Payton II and Gui Santos are day-to-day with knee issues and are game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Pelicans lost the 2025-26 season series 1-2, though they won their most recent meeting 113-109 in New Orleans on February 24, 2026.
